extension.description: An IntelliJ IDEA-style Git and CVS workspace for VS Code.
workspace.trust: JetTortoise runs local Git and CVS commands and requires a trusted workspace.
config.cvsPath: Path to the local CVS executable. No client is downloaded automatically.
config.autoDiscoverRepositories: Recursively discover Git/CVS repositories inside trusted workspace folders without scanning ancestors or performing network operations. Disabling this retains the saved list; manual scanning remains available.
